# sfcompute_sku_availability (Data Source)

Reads sku availability from SF Compute (`GET /v2/skus/{id}/availability`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) SKU ID

### Read-Only

- `schedule` (Attributes List) Node counts available for purchase over time. Empty when the SKU has no published availability. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `sku` (Attributes) A SKU referenced by id and alias. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sku))

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `node_count` (Number)
- `start_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.


<a id="nestedatt--sku"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sku`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) A short, unique among live, human-recognizable name for this SKU. For display only - reference the SKU by `id`.
- `id` (String)
